1. Case overview

Summary. 7 plans: 6 DMAT variants and 1 reference plan.

Clinical background and rationale. Multi-site SBRT. 30 Gy in 5 fractions

Plan generation. DMAT plan generated for: Accela. DMAT: 10FFF, 2 arcs; modulation -3, -2, -1, 0, +1, +2. Reference setup: VMAT-4-iso: 10FFF, 8 arcs.

Goal setup. 35 provided goals per DMAT plan. Goal thresholds and priorities are listed in the planning tables; derived and supporting objectives are separate. Example from DA289: Spinal canal D0.03 cm3 ≤ 28.00 Gy (P1.1).

Comparison methods. Compared the dose colorwash, DVHs, quality–time graph and individual endpoint–time graphs. Dose normalization factors: 1. DMAT: Matched delivery metrics; VMAT-4-iso: RT Plan control-point estimate. Durations do not represent total room time.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice.

Dose viewer loads when visible.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

5 GyRx 30 Gy45 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DA289’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. Scroll over an image or use arrow keys to change slices. Dragging is disabled. Centered zoom (+/−) and reset (0 or double-click) remain synchronized. All plans use the confirmed 0–45 Gy color scale.

Scoring method

Saved score curves, weights and thresholds are retained. The endpoint count summary classifies results as goal, acceptable variation or deviation; missing or unmapped endpoints contribute zero points. Native technical-report compliance scores remain separate.
